title: Pendragon
summary: Pendragon is the Legendary Titan of Champions, whose Amulet was housed inside the Willblade, the legendary Casterwill sword of Avalon. As the Legendary Titan of Champions, Pendragon's Seeker must be a champion chosen directly by Lord Casterwill. Pendragon has now become Powerbonded to the current champion, Lok Lambert, having unlocked his true power during his final battle against The Betrayer.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Pendragon was originally the Titan of the Champion of Casterwill while the elder daughter of Casterwill held the Legendary Titan of Summons, Quetzalcoatl, in the Willblade. Together with the Champion, this Titan became a great help in the fight against the Betrayer and also against the Nullifiers. When the Nullifers were defeated, he used the power of Pendragon in the Willblade to seal the Blood Spiral's dark power. [The Spiral Mark]

Some time after the conflict, Pendragon's Amulet was placed inside the Willblade until a worthy Seeker could awaken the Titan once again. The young Seeker, Lok Lambert, was the one destined to bond with Pendragon as proclaimed by the prophecies of Nostradamus. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

On Avalon, to save Sophie Casterwill's life, Lok took possession of the Willblade and fought off attacks from Incubane, Divine Mirror Kagami, and Dendras, under the control of Wilder. He then invoked Pendragon who swiftly defeated the enemy Titans and broke Wilder's control over Dendras before returning to his Amulet inside the Willblade. However neither Lok, Sophie or Cherit were able to remember the events that took place. [Knight of the Willblade] In the Casterwill Library in France, Lok discovered Pendragon's Amulet after solving the puzzle on the Willblade's handle but could not detect a bond. Dante Vale tried to scan the Amulet on the Holotome but it was protected by an unfamiliar power. [Chasing Void]

While trapped in a dreamworld created by Arc, the Legendary Titan of Fate, Lok followed the advice of a spectral Eathon Lambert and invoked Pendragon to defeat a whole group of Harlekin Titans and escape from the dream. [The Legendary Titan of Fate] The mystery of Pendragon's Amulet was still puzzling him on the boat journey to the island of Medusa. [Zhalia's Mission] During a ritual led by the Rue Guardians, a spectral form of Pendragon appeared from behind Lok and Powerbonded Kipperin and defeated Kiel's Efreet King, once again saving Sophie's life. [The Spiral War]

While on a mission to capture Rassimov, Lok is worried over the seriousness of being unable to invoke Pendragon. He later tried to summon him to stop Legion, the Legendary Titan of War but failed, with the team ultimately losing both Lindorm and Solwing to
Legion's Titan Absorption ability. [Rassimov's Secret] Resting at Sandra Lambert's house in Ireland, Dante told Lok not to blame himself for the events with Rassimov. While lost in the Inter-dimensional World at Tír na nÓg, Lok was finally able to bond with Pendragon with the help of his father Eathon. However Eathon warned that the Blood Spiral might He then invoked Pendragon to save his friends from numerous Dullahan and Firbolg Titans. [Back Home]

During the final battle against the Betrayer, Pendragon's Amulet independently emerged from the Willblade to save Lok from Demigorgan, the Titan of Betrayal. Pendragon was then revealed to have become Powerbonded, defeating the Titan copies of Sabriel, Raijin and Gareon created by Demigorgan. The Betrayer, having fought Pendragon before, had Demigorgan create a Seeker mimic of his original Seeker, the Champion of Casterwill, preventing Pendragon from fighting. [Dante's Return]

Lok later invoked Powerbonded Pendragon to fight Myrmidon and Shadow Agent whilst looking for the Amulet of Kyojin in the ruins of Yonaguni. Although he managed to defeat Shadow Agent, Pendragon was then attacked by Grand Façade. After Lok found the Amulet, he summoned Kyojin, causing a huge whirlpool, knocking all of the Seekers and Titans backwards. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E34 Harlekins Pendragon.png|class=bob|thumb|Pendragon vaporizes two [[Harlekin]] Titans]]
Because of his huge size, Pendragon possesses incredible strength and endurance, and this alone means he can shred smaller Titans to pieces. He can also fire energy blasts from his mouth, easily sending Titans as powerful as [[Firbolg]] back to their amulets. {{Source|Back Home}} When his Amulet is inside the [[Willblade]], it can manifest blasts of energy, shockwaves, energy shields and those powers could even dissipate powerful [[Titans]] with one strike. Pendragon can also break enchantments such as [[Divine Mirror Kagami]]'s controlling of [[Dendras]]. {{source|Knight of the Willblade}}

sections.heading: Powerbonding
sections.text:
Image caption: Bladeflare heavily damages and knock backs Demigorgan

Pendragon became Powerbonded with Lok Lambert during the battle against the Betrayer and Demigorgan. Through Powerbonding, Pendragon gained several new abilities:

• Bladeflare - channels his power to be emitted directly from the Willblade. [Dante's Return]
• Energy Sword Breath - enables him to breathe a shower of energy swords that fall onto enemies, inflicting massive damage. [Dante's Return]

Pendragon's size and figure also changed, making him physically stronger and able to walk on his hind legs more easily. He is thus far the only known Legendary Titan to have become Powerbonded. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* His summoning command is: "'''Awaken'''."

* Pendragon's name was based on the epithet of Pendragon which was born by [[wikipedia:Uther Pendragon|Uther Pendragon]], the father of the legendary King Arthur, as well as by [[King Arthur]] himself. This title means "head-dragon" or "chieftain" in Welsh. Pendragon's appearance is based on that of a dragon.

* The [[Willblade]], containing Pendragon's Amulet, was found in Avalon on a stone altar much like the sword ''Caliburnus'', or Caliburn, in Arthurian lore. Also known as the Sword of Selection, this sword is sometimes considered to be the same as [[wikipedia:Excalibur]] or the Sword in the Stone in modern interpretations. These swords were associated with the Pendragon lineage.

* Powerbonded Pendragon's design incorporates aspects resembling Quetzalcoatl's head and Overlos' wings.
